source_evidence: Add-only correction to earlier abbreviated snapshot interpretation. Independent complete-loop/owner review SHA256 075f547cd4537cfdf699bdfabc77701fe0f1820437895b01f47f87f3b73f9658 confirms original4E1A85 loads width before iteration zero,4E1A9E samples flatness inside each iteration, and4E1BB8 reloads width after per-tile/landmark work for the next backedge. It is not one unchanging width snapshot for the entire loop. Retain prior diagnostic reports/journal history with this correction, rather than rewriting evidence.

Typed MapStorage.metadata_ owns dimensions/flatness, with separately allocated Map tiles. Relevant bit/code/landmark helpers do not change these metadata fields; no map-size callback/message pump occurs in this loop, and the receive worker queues I/O rather than applying world state there. On evidenced stable inputs, current common-per-iteration loading and original entry/backedge loading yield the same values. Concurrent mutation would race ordinary nonvolatile metadata and is unsupported/unproved; no semantic correction, volatile/alias trick, blanket caching or additional source scope is justified.

This incorporates the requested investigation and its source-ownership/lifetime findings, not byte-exact completion. Exact load placements and the full mapped editor_natural body/EH spans remain in the original subject scope as matching restoration work. The source and claims remain unchanged, natural remains MISMATCH, native outside-one FAIL and the precisely expanded outside-two pass remain recorded, and the compiler trigger for unrelated root scheduling is still unproved. No runtime/game, complete linked preservation or automatic acceptance claim.
